text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is reading a fan letter<n>one day in my
office and smiles to<n>herself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The way your intellect shines in your<n>eyes through
your glasses is<n>wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I adore your intelligent running style.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It feels strange to be praised for my<n>glasses. After
all, I only wear them for<n>the sake of correcting my
weak<n>vision.
choice_data_list: Still, your fans find them appealing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I can use how others see me<n>to create a
more favorable image of<n>myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
These fan letters provide great insight<n>into how
others regard me and what<n>they expect from me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As someone who's constantly in the<n>public eye, I
must do my best to retain<n>my fans' support.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to take greater care in how I<n>present
myself and refine the<n>attributes that set me apart
from<n>others.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I'll start with the<n>way I clean my
glasses.

I can't help but notice the sense of<n>pride that
emanates from her as she<n>adjusts her glasses.
